description: This file contains styles for the note form component used in the frontend web application. It includes styles for the form layout, input fields, buttons, and media queries for responsive design.

classes.name: note-form
classes.description: Main class for the note form, defining layout, background, padding, and border properties.

classes.name: note-form-field
classes.description: Class for individual fields in the note form, handling layout and spacing.

classes.name: note-form-error
classes.description: Class for styling the error message displayed in the note form.

classes.name: note-form-actions
classes.description: Class for the container of action buttons in the note form.

classes.name: note-form-btn
classes.description: Class for styling the buttons in the note form, including hover effects.
